osm.parent_contract: The original clock-osm frequency table fixes LMH selector 1 to 300 MHz, divided by 1.5. No frequency-counter measurement or unverified physical parent wiring is claimed.

notes: Existing clock-osm.c and xiaomi-clock-osm.c pin the OSM source/HID contract; their provenance is tracked in the existing reference manifests.
Firmware bridge uses no ClockDxe suffix or unavailable named clock; post-EBS acquisition uses direct RCG/CBCR registers.
sequence_review: The original aux, OSM and RBCPR rcg definitions do not set non_local_children, non_local_control_timeout or force_enable_rcgr. clock-local2.c rcg_clk_set_rate therefore writes CFG and latches UPDATE without forcing the old source first. The bridge follows that sequence, then retains ROOT_EN and verifies ROOT_OFF is clear; it also checks CMD dirty bits before accepting evidence.
